request.initial_prompt: Having uttered these words in an agitated voice the Emperor suddenly turned away as if to hide from Michaud the tears that rose to his eyes, and went to the further end of his study. Having stood there a few moments, he strode back to Michaud and pressed his arm below the elbow with a vigorous movement. The Emperor's mild and handsome face was flushed and his eyes gleamed with resolution and anger.

raw_segments.text: Having uttered these words in an agitated voice the Emperor suddenly turned away as if to hide from Michaud the tears that rose to his eyes, and went to the further end of his study.
Having stood there a few moments, he strode back to Michaud and pressed his arm below the elbow with a vigorous movement.
The Emperor's mild and handsome face was flushed and his eyes gleamed with resolution and anger.
